devdoc.details: Borrower adapter used by `IdleCDOEpochVariant` for revolving-credit facilities. It has two jobs: 1. keep undrawn capital parked inside an ERC4626 vault 2. track interest owed by the real borrower when that capital is temporarily drawn IdleCDOEpochVariant only orchestrates the epoch lifecycle and reads a single stop-epoch interest value from this contract. The detailed split between vault yield and borrower interest stays here.

borrow(uint256).details: Only the configured borrower address can call this while an epoch is active. If there is not enough on-hand liquidity, the shortfall is first withdrawn from the vault.

params.assets: amount of underlying to draw (`0` = draw all currently available)

returns.withdrawnShares: vault shares burned, if any liquidity had to be freed first

emergencyExitVault(uint256).details: Owner or manager. Pass 0 to redeem all shares.

params._shares: number of vault shares to redeem (0 = redeem all)

executeBorrow(uint256).details: Funds are still transferred only to the configured borrower address.

params.assets: amount of underlying to draw (`0` = draw all currently available)

returns.withdrawnShares: vault shares burned, if any liquidity had to be freed first

executeRepay(uint256).details: Funds are still pulled only from the configured borrower address using its allowance.

params.assets: amount of underlying to repay (`0` = repay all currently owed)

returns.interestPaid: interest component cleared by the repayment
returns.principalPaid: principal component cleared by the repayment

params._borrower: real borrower address allowed to draw and repay
params._borrowerApr: borrower APR expressed as a percentage scaled by 1e18
params._idleCDO: IdleCDOEpochVariant contract allowed to pull funds
params._manager: routine manager allowed to operate facility admin actions
params._vault: ERC4626 vault where funds will be deployed

onDefault().details: This keeps borrower-side epoch state aligned with IdleCDO's stopped/defaulted state when the stop hook could not complete successfully.

params._pendingWithdraws: pending withdraw requests amount to reserve for epoch end.

params._amountRequired: total amount IdleCDO will pull via transferFrom.
params._isRequestingAllFunds: whether IdleCDO is closing the pool and recalling all funds.

returns.success: false when the borrower ledger makes close-pool settlement a real default.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

repay(uint256).details: Repayments are applied in this order: 1. `borrowerInterestDebt` already fronted by IdleCDO 2. `borrowerInterestAccrued` not yet fronted 3. `borrowerPrincipal` Passing `assets = 0` repays the full currently tracked obligation. Amounts above the tracked debt are capped to the live obligation before any transfer. When an epoch is active, the received funds are redeployed into the vault before the function returns.

params.assets: amount of underlying to repay (`0` = repay all currently owed)

returns.interestPaid: interest component cleared by the repayment
returns.principalPaid: principal component cleared by the repayment

rescueTokens(address,address,uint256).details: This is fully owner-trusted and can move the underlying as well, so it should only be used to recover stuck funds or to unwind a broken external integration.

params._allowed: true to authorize, false to revoke

setBorrower(address).details: Owner or manager. This is only allowed while the facility is idle with no borrower-side principal or interest exposure left to reconcile.

setBorrowerApr(uint256).details: Owner or manager. Checkpoints accrued interest at the old rate before applying the new APR.

params._apr: borrower APR expressed as a percentage scaled by 1e18

setManager(address).details: The owner can set this to the zero address to disable manager permissions.

params._manager: manager address, or zero to clear the role

setVault(address).details: Owner or manager. This does not migrate an existing position. The operator must first withdraw from the old vault and wait until epoch accounting is inactive, otherwise assets can remain stranded there and the live accounting views will stop including them after the switch.

settleBorrowerInterest().details: Called by IdleCDO only on the success path of `stopEpoch`. If the CDO's `transferFrom` fails (default), this is never called and borrower interest stays in `borrowerInterestAccrued`. Borrower debt is intentionally settled at the full contractual borrower-interest amount, without netting vault gains or losses against it.

totalInterestDueNow().details: This is the single value read by IdleCDO to price the epoch: borrower contractual interest plus positive vault PnL minus vault losses. It is a pool-facing value, so it can be lower than `borrowerInterestDebt` when the borrower still owes full contractual interest but the vault sleeve suffered a loss.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

borrowerInterestAccrued.details: This tracks only the real borrower's credit-facility interest and is independent from gains or losses generated by the vault sleeve.

borrowerInterestDebt.details: This can be greater than the same epoch's net pool interest if the vault sleeve had a loss. Vault PnL stays in pool accounting; borrower debt stays purely contractual.

bufferStartVaultAssets.details: Used to measure vault PnL generated during the buffer so it is carried into the next epoch.

bufferedVaultDelta.details: Positive values represent gains, negative values represent losses.

authorizedExecutors(address).notice: keepers allowed to trigger borrow and repay on behalf of the borrower

availableToBorrow().notice: current borrowable liquidity excluding reserved withdraw requests

borrow(uint256).notice: Draw funds from the revolving-credit facility.

borrower().notice: real borrower address allowed to draw/repay

borrowerApr().notice: fixed APR charged to borrower debt (100e18 = 100% APR)

borrowerInterestAccrued().notice: borrower contractual interest accrued but not yet settled to IdleCDO

borrowerInterestAccruedNow().notice: borrower interest accrued since epoch start up to now (includes uncheckpointed interest)

borrowerInterestDebt().notice: borrower contractual interest already settled to IdleCDO but not yet repaid

borrowerInterestOwedNow().notice: total borrower interest still owed by the real borrower

bufferStartVaultAssets().notice: vault assets left invested when the previous epoch stopped

bufferedVaultDelta().notice: net vault PnL earned during the buffer and not yet realized by IdleCDO

emergencyExitVault(uint256).notice: Emergency escape: redeem vault shares back to this contract.

epochDepositedToVault().notice: cumulative assets deposited to vault during epoch

epochPendingWithdraws().notice: pending withdraw requests amount reserved for the epoch

epochStartVaultAssets().notice: Vault assets held at epoch start (baseline)

epochWithdrawnFromVault().notice: cumulative assets withdrawn from vault during epoch

executeBorrow(uint256).notice: Trigger a borrower draw from an authorized executor.

executeRepay(uint256).notice: Trigger a borrower repayment from an authorized executor.

idleCDO().notice: IdleCDOEpochVariant address allowed to pull funds

lastBorrowerAccrual().notice: last timestamp borrower interest was accrued

manager().notice: allowed to operate routine facility admin actions

onDefault().notice: Abort active epoch accounting after IdleCDO defaulted the facility.

onStartEpoch(uint256).notice: Hook called by IdleCDOEpochVariant when a new epoch starts. It deposits all on-hand assets into the vault and starts accounting.

onStopEpoch(uint256,bool).notice: Hook called by IdleCDOEpochVariant before stopping an epoch. Withdraws enough liquidity from the vault so IdleCDO can pull funds.

repay(uint256).notice: Repay drawn funds back into the facility.

setAuthorizedExecutor(address,bool).notice: Allow or revoke a keeper that can trigger borrow and repay on behalf of the borrower.

setBorrower(address).notice: Set the real borrower allowed to draw and repay funds.

setBorrowerApr(uint256).notice: Set the fixed APR charged on drawn borrower principal (100e18 = 100% APR).

setManager(address).notice: Set or clear the routine manager role.

setVault(address).notice: Set the vault used to deploy idle funds.

settleBorrowerInterest().notice: Settle accrued borrower interest into debt after IdleCDO successfully fronted it.

totalInterestDueNow().notice: Total net epoch interest due to the pool at stop.

totalUnderlying().notice: Return the total exposure in underlying terms (on-hand plus vault position).

underlyingToken().notice: underlying token (must match the vault asset)

vault().notice: ERC4626 vault where idle funds are deployed

vaultInterestAccrued().notice: interest accrued in the vault since the last `startEpochAccounting`

vaultLoss().notice: unrealized loss from the vault position since epoch start

vaultSharesBalance().notice: Return the current vault share balance held by this contract.
